## THIS WEEK'S BIG PICTURE

### 🏥 RECOVERY — TRANSITION WEEK

Per Dr. Corrado's original 9-week protocol:
- **May 11–13 (Mon–Wed):** Still Week 9 — 50% taper
- **May 14 (Thu):** Full clearance begins

**However:** The setback in late April paused the protocol. The real question is whether Ibrahim has been reassessed and where he actually stands. Until Fatima confirms, this schedule treats the week conservatively — no soccer practice, YMCA stays PM-only, no high-impact lower body work.

**If Ibrahim IS cleared to return to practice this week:** The Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday blocks need to be restructured for practice days (shorter academics, earlier dinner, leave at 6:00/7:00/7:10 PM, late bedtime 10:45 PM). Ask Claude to regenerate those three days if this is the case.

### 📚 ALGEBRA 2 — CH2 BEGINS (QUADRATIC FUNCTIONS)

Assuming Ch1 is complete: this week opens Chapter 2. Quadratic functions are the heart of Algebra 2 — this chapter matters more than almost any other. The four sections are:
- **2.1:** Transformations of Quadratic Functions
- **2.2:** Characteristics of Quadratic Functions (vertex, axis, roots)
- **2.3:** Focus of a Parabola
- **2.4:** Modeling with Quadratic Functions

Ch2 builds directly on Ch1's transformations. If those landed well, Ch2 will flow. If Ch1 is still shaky — spend the early part of this week reinforcing it before pushing into Ch2.

### 🌙 QURAN — SURA AL-MULK CONTINUED

Continuing the progressive build through Sura Al-Mulk (30 ayat total). Assuming ~15 ayat are solidified. Goal this week: push through ayat 16–25, and keep Juz Amma review (An-Nas backward) alive on weekends.

### 💤 SLEEP THIS WEEK

If no practice: **9:30 PM bedtime every school night** → wake 6:15 AM = 8.75 hours. Weekend: 9:30 PM → wake 6:30–7:00 AM = 9+ hours. No excuses this week — sleep is the recovery tool.
